probes.name: macro-application-evaluate
probes.source:
Public SourceCell As Range
Public UseSheet As Boolean
Public LastLeaf As String
Public LastOuter As String
Public Calls As Long
Function FreshLeaf() As Variant
Dim obj As Object,child As Object,v As Variant,n As Long
Dim stage As String,kind As String,childKind As String,callerKind As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Calls=Calls+1
stage="caller"
callerKind=TypeName(Application.Caller)
stage="acquire"
Set obj=SourceCell.DisplayFormat
kind=TypeName(obj)
stage="child"
Set child=obj.Font
childKind=TypeName(child)
stage="read"
v=child.Bold
LastLeaf="err=0;stage=done;object=" & kind & ";child=" & childKind & ";read=" & CStr(v) & ";caller=" & callerKind
FreshLeaf=v
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
LastLeaf="err=" & CStr(n) & ";stage=" & stage & ";object=" & kind & ";child=" & childKind & ";caller=" & callerKind
FreshLeaf=CVErr(2015)
End Function
Function EvalWrapper() As Variant
Dim v As Variant,n As Long,callerKind As String
On Error GoTo Failed
callerKind=TypeName(Application.Caller)
If UseSheet Then
v=SourceCell.Parent.Evaluate("FreshLeaf()")
Else
v=Application.Evaluate("FreshLeaf()")
End If
LastOuter="err=0;caller=" & callerKind & ";result=" & CStr(v) & ";vartype=" & CStr(VarType(v))
EvalWrapper=v
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
LastOuter="err=" & CStr(n) & ";caller=" & callerKind
EvalWrapper=CVErr(2015)
End Function
Function Snapshot(v As Variant) As String
Snapshot="value=" & CStr(v) & ";vartype=" & CStr(VarType(v)) & ";called=" & CStr(Calls>0) & ";outer=[" & LastOuter & "];leaf=[" & LastLeaf & "]"
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,consumer As Range,f As FormatCondition,v As Variant,first As String,n As Long
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set SourceCell=host.Worksheets(1).Range("A1")
SourceCell.Value=7
SourceCell.Font.Bold=False
Set f=SourceCell.FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=TRUE")
f.Font.Bold=True
Set consumer=host.Worksheets(1).Range("B1")
UseSheet=False
v=EvalWrapper()
Probe=Snapshot(v)
GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
n=Err.Number
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";outer=[" & LastOuter & "];leaf=[" & LastLeaf & "]"
Cleanup:
Set SourceCell=Nothing
End Function
